title: Sharing managed Iceberg tables is now generally available
body: Sharing [managed Iceberg tables](/aws/en/tables/managed) in Databricks-to-Databricks sharing and open sharing is now generally available. Providers can now also share managed Iceberg tables to external Iceberg clients. See [Add managed Iceberg tables to a share](/aws/en/opensharing/create-share#managed-iceberg) and [Read shared managed Iceberg tables](/aws/en/opensharing/read-data-databricks#managed-iceberg).

ref_links.text: Add managed Iceberg tables to a share
